        ## 2. What this preview provides
        
        The Free preview includes `sample`, `extract`, explicit-file `report`, `render`,
        and `version`. It produces self-contained HTML and packed JSON at Free triage
        depth. The report is timeline-first. It retains up to four events per affected
        order and five clean-order summaries, shows broad anomaly categories, and omits
        raw FIX, exact anomaly codes, and full evidence chains from the report. Direct
        extract output preserves selected FIX messages and is not redacted.
        
        For larger logs, use direct identifier extraction from one supported
        line-oriented file, then generate a report from the extract. Each message must
        be complete on one physical line, within the supported format and 1 MiB line
        limit. Extraction has a 10,000-message match cap. Selectors use OR; extraction
        does not expand order chains or restore missing context.

        10,000,000 aggregate bytes is refused unless you explicitly use
        `--force-large-input`. That override can exhaust memory or make the machine
        unresponsive. The message cap does not guarantee that an extract fits these
        byte limits. These limits are operating boundaries, not performance promises.
